question: Aman Sehrawat became the first Indian to win a gold medal in World Wrestling Championship in which category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**U-23**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aman Sehrawat** became the first Indian to win a gold medal in the **U-23** category at the **World Wrestling Championship**.
 
• This achievement marks a significant milestone in Indian wrestling history, showcasing the nation's growing strength in the sport at the international level.
 
• The U-23 category is a competitive age group that bridges the gap between junior and senior levels, providing a platform for young wrestlers to gain experience and recognition.
 
• Aman's victory is expected to inspire many young athletes in India to pursue wrestling and aim for excellence in international competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The World Wrestling Championships are conducted annually by the **United World Wrestling (UWW)**, the international governing body for the sport of wrestling.
 
• India has been progressively improving its performance in wrestling on the global stage, with several wrestlers winning medals in various categories over the years.
 
• Training and support for wrestlers in India have seen significant enhancements, contributing to the rising success in international competitions.
 
• Aman's achievement is a testament to the hard work and dedication of Indian wrestlers, coaches, and the sports ecosystem supporting them.
